Finding: Bookmark requests can use a newly active account from a stale tab
Remediation: Require a valid intended actor on all bookmark reads/writes; preserve server session validation.
Acceptance: Account A intent with account B session returns 401 before private query/RPC.

Finding: Public rate-limit RPCs permit bucket resets and poisoning
Evidence: verified isolated PostgreSQL + offline guest/server regressions
Remediation: Revoke browser ledger mutation in a reversible migration; use service credentials only for quota with trusted ingress IP and fixed limits.
Acceptance: Direct anon/authenticated mutation denied; server quota and guest flows pass.

Finding: Self-asserted social handles can qualify for automatic mission approval
Remediation: Keep self-asserted matches in manual review; require independent account-ownership evidence for auto-approval.
Acceptance: Claiming another author handle cannot auto-approve or create an automatic pending obligation.

Finding: Scan retries bypass the three-job daily ceiling
Evidence: RED-to-GREEN offline handlers + fresh isolated PostgreSQL reservation races/expiry/rollback
Remediation: Use one durable service-only reservation RPC/ledger for scan and verification; atomically charge initial scans and retries with job creation/reset.
Dependencies: 24h old-worker launch pause and separate approved migration cutover; exact-head isolated CI
Acceptance: Initial and retry launches share quota; concurrent requests cannot overspend it; expiry restores allowance.

Finding: Default tests can mutate an unverified configured database
Remediation: Default worker tests are offline; explicit DB configs require synthetic local target attestation and matching signing keys before clients/hooks; reader also attests disposable MySQL.
Acceptance: Cloud/mismatched credentials fail before client creation; only attested synthetic local target can mutate.

Finding: Sync webhook buffers an unlimited unauthenticated body
Evidence: verified bounded streaming + original-byte HMAC regressions; external exposure unknown
Remediation: Read at most 64 KiB of actual streamed bytes before HMAC/JSON; cancel overflow and return 413 even with understated Content-Length.
Dependencies: Deployment ingress ceiling remains unverified; app bound is independent
Acceptance: Oversized or streaming body receives 413 with bounded buffering; valid signed events pass.

Finding: Public privacy notice and request contact remain incomplete
Remediation: Approve full privacy/support copy, request channel, retention and processor disclosures; publish approved content.
Acceptance: Both locales expose approved notice and working request path matching actual backend behavior.

Finding: Verification concurrency and daily quota check is not atomic with reservation
Evidence: RED-to-GREEN offline handlers + gated independent PostgreSQL connection races
Remediation: Reserve owner concurrency and daily launches with job creation/retry in the same shared owner-locked transaction; preserve per-submission uniqueness.
Dependencies: Shared AUD-04 reservation migration; exact-head isolated CI
Acceptance: Parallel distinct submissions never exceed remaining owner concurrency/daily budget.

Finding: Default app has no lint coverage
Remediation: Add Journeys lint task/config and include it in root lint.
Acceptance: A deliberate unused binding in Journeys fails the documented lint command.

Remediation: Remove 14 individual Radix declarations and parity mysql2 declaration; regenerate the authoritative lockfile and verify builds.
Acceptance: Source imports still resolve from their actual direct owner; frozen install and affected tests/build pass.

Finding: Bookmark transport exceptions are classified as invalid input
Remediation: Separate parse/validation errors from unknown mutation outcomes; return retryable 503 without provider details.
Acceptance: Malformed JSON returns 400 before mutation; thrown RPC returns retryable 503.

Finding: Rapid bookmark removal clicks issue distinct commands; invalidation leaves stale handler active
Remediation: Use synchronous removal/account guards, reset pending UI on invalidation and ignore late responses.
Acceptance: Two immediate clicks issue one command; retry retains requestId; stale handler sends nothing after invalidation.
